verdict.rationale: The Department publishes processing-time commitments only for paid expedited service: 24 hours for $25, same day for $75, and 2 hours for $150 per document. Those tiers appear alongside the filing rails for this transaction type. Nothing in the evidence shows current or standard (non-expedited) processing times or backlog for a Certificate of Incorporation, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: published current standard processing times for this transaction type, regularly updated or live backlog figures, and processing times for the online versus mail rails.
